features: Enjoy clear visuals on the spacious 2.4" wide display
Experience the elegance of a premium glass back design with the it5262
Power through your day with the 2000 mAh big battery and Type C charger, exclusively available with Itel keypad phones
Effortlessly record and organize your calls with automatic call recording
King Voice feature reads out short messages, menus, and phone calls in both English and Hindi, offering convenient accessibility for daily tasks.
description: Introducing the itel Premium Glass-Like Back Design Feature Phone, boasting a vibrant 2.4-inch display for immersive visuals. With the King Voice feature, enjoy convenient access to messages, menus, and calls in both English and Hindi. Stay connected effortlessly with support for a 32GB expandable memory. Dive into wireless FM entertainment on the move. Plus, with a robust 2000 mAh battery, enjoy an impressive 12 days of backup. Featuring Vibration mode, Auto Call Recording, expanded memory, and extended battery life, the itel Premium Glass-Like Back Design Feature Phone offers a comprehensive mobile solution for an uninterrupted and enriched user experience.
